GhostMap an interactive 3D time machine of Cornell

Geographically grounded · time-aware · visually immersive. Licensed internet photographs, reconstructed with COLMAP, placed without GPS inside the world's own 3D model (public USGS lidar), rendered as Gaussian splats that the lidar checks and teaches, and replayed over twenty years. Each chapter is a few steps: what you see, what it does, what came out.
